Usage: osstack attention status --db /absolute/state.db --task ID --repo /absolute/repo --default-tenant [--json] [--cursor TOKEN]
Read-only snapshot. No daemon is started and no database is migrated.
Live process state is unknown; this command does not establish background supervision.
Opt-in daemon: OSSTACK_ATTENTION=1 osstack serve
  attention watch --task ID --repo PATH --default-tenant
  attention inbox|inventory|deliveries --scope ID [--after ID] [--json]
  attention get --scope ID --item ID
  attention answer --scope ID --item ID --action ID --revision N --content-hash HASH --text TEXT [--takeover --grant ID]
  attention release --scope ID --kind session|run|loop --subject ID --expected-version N
  attention abandon-receipt --scope ID --session ID --message ID --expected-version N --reason TEXT --evidence-sha256 HASH --acknowledge-unknown-effects
  attention recovery --scope ID [--after CURSOR] [--limit 1..25] [--json]
  attention brief|cockpit --scope ID --actor NAME
  attention posture --scope ID --actor NAME --posture attended|quiet|away
  attention seen --scope ID --actor NAME --revisions JSON
  attention foreground --scope ID --subjects JSON
  attention handoff --scope ID --client ID --token TOKEN
  attention turn-end --scope ID --client ID --token TOKEN --role foreground_owner
  attention loop --scope ID --loop-id ID --state-path PATH
  attention ci --scope ID --github-repo OWNER/REPO --pr N --head SHA --required JSON
  attention claude-hook --binding-file PATH
  attention lesson --from-run ID --repo PATH --default-tenant [--dry-run] [--json]
  attention triage --scope ID --item ID --model EXACT [--json]
  attention triage --status --scope ID [--json]
  attention contract|routing-eval|triage|context|lesson --input PATH [--json]
Legacy --input planning uses supplied data only; it does not verify execution. Runtime V2: deliver --contract FILE.
See docs/guides/attention.md for planning flags and verified hook setup.
No daemon is automatically started. Hooks are explicit calls; no offline watchdog is installed.

osstack scout inspect --repo PATH --goal TEXT --path FILE [--path FILE] --profile NAME --request-id ID
osstack scout promote --scout DIGEST --request-id ID
Inspect reads bounded committed files only. Promote explicitly starts fresh guarded-local delivery; it never inherits approval or publishes.

sources inspect SOURCE_ID --repo ABSOLUTE_PATH --default-tenant [--json]
Read only an explicitly host-registered, pinned local snapshot. No actions or automatic context injection.

sources observe|events|acknowledge SOURCE_ID --repo ABSOLUTE_PATH --default-tenant [--after SEQUENCE] [--grant GRANT_ID] [--json]
Observe persists sequence evidence; events reads its bounded journal. Acknowledge requires an exact private host grant. Events reports clock high-water; a short-lived clock_reset grant quarantines other streams while recovering the approved source. Clock recovery requires a fresh registered snapshot for an existing stream; source-context dispatch and acknowledgement require an OSSTACK_HOME path with no symlink components (use its resolved path). Observe/status/events do not enforce this canonical-path rule.

worker list --repo ABSOLUTE_PATH --default-tenant [--limit 1..50] [--cursor TOKEN] [--json]
worker inspect VIEW_ID --repo ABSOLUTE_PATH --default-tenant [--json]
Read-only Session and bound-run state views. Graph and log tails are not supported.
Views and cursors expire after 15 minutes or a daemon restart.

remote-home inspect --registry FILE --sha256 HASH --alias NAME [--limit 1..50]
Read a pinned remote home through fixed SSH stdio; partial pages and transport failures remain explicit.

remote-home cancel|query --registry FILE --sha256 HASH --alias NAME --grant FILE
Signed exact Graph cancellation only. Local durable attempt precedes transport; repeat cancel becomes query, never resend.
Remote stop_requested is not physical stopped proof. Missing/offline receipts remain unknown.
not_sent reports only a new local invocation that failed before reserve/transport; it does not attest remote state.

remote-home issue-cancel-grant --target NAME --daemon-generation INSTANCE --graph-run ID --graph-generation N --revision N --output FILE
Requires host-private remote-cancel-issuer.json, issuer-KEY.pem, local interactive TTY and exact preview digest approval.
Creates only one bounded generation/revision-specific cancellation grant. Does not connect or cancel. No --yes or RPC signer.

follow-up-delivery prepare --repo PATH --default-tenant --input FILE [--json]
follow-up-delivery list --repo PATH --default-tenant [--limit 1..50] [--after ID] [--json]
follow-up-delivery inspect ID --repo PATH --default-tenant [--json]
follow-up-delivery authorize ID --repo PATH --default-tenant --revision N --grant FILE [--json]
follow-up-delivery revoke ID --repo PATH --default-tenant --revision N --reason TEXT [--json]
follow-up-delivery dispatch|reconcile ID --repo PATH --default-tenant --revision N [--json]
GitHub delivery is disabled unless the host installs a private follow-up-delivery.json registry, credential, and trusted issuer key.
Absent transport stays qualification_pending and never consumes authorization.
Authorize imports a signed, host-trusted, exact-target/body/scope/single-attempt grant.
Local issue-grant requires a host-provisioned private issuer and interactive exact-preview approval; RPC callers cannot create authority.
Prepare input excludes repo_path/default_tenant. Unknown delivery never retries; reconcile only queries a registered provider.
JSON output preserves exact reviewable content. Dispatch/reconcile exit 0 only for production-qualified delivered evidence; fake and sandbox evidence exit 1.
Delivery does not resolve the independent local obligation.

homes inspect --manifest FILE [--json]
Read only explicitly pinned local home identities; never upgrades or opens databases.
